_comment: Category min-duration availability feasibility check added 2026-09-26 (docs/category-min-duration-availability-design.md §8, feel & heal pilot). Covers: the check fires only when a category-availability question arrives BEFORE any tier/add-on/duration is stated; a fully-specified booking in the same breath skips it entirely; found=false offers escape routes (different day / the other treatment) before falling to a message, never continuing to narrow the declined treatment; found=true continues into the normal narrowing questions; check_failed=true (a lookup problem, not a real answer) is handled silently by falling through to normal narrowing with zero mention of availability. Revised 2026-09-26 after an adversarial review found the original found=false scenario's PASS wording ('closely matching the tool's message') would also pass a violation of the node's own 'never speak message verbatim' rule, and mocked a message value production never actually returns for that path (the real backend returns no message key at all when a category search finds zero practitioners).

scenarios.name: Category + availability question, nothing else stated — check fires before any narrowing

history.content: Does anyone have space for a remedial massage today?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks exactly one filler phrase (e.g. 'One moment.') then calls universal_router intent='category_availability_check' with payload service_category='remedial_massage', with zero other questions asked first (no add-on question, no tier question, no duration question). FAIL if agent asks about add-ons/tier/duration before checking, or calls confirm_service directly, or calls any tool other than universal_router.

scenarios.name: Category named WITH tier/duration already stated — skip the check entirely, narrow normally

history.content: I'd like a remedial massage with Gene, 60 minutes.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent does NOT call category_availability_check at all (the caller has already fully specified tier via naming Gene and duration via '60 minutes', so this is a normal booking, not a feasibility question) — agent should proceed toward confirm_service (may ask about add-ons first, per the ADD-ON QUESTION rule, since that wasn't stated). FAIL if agent calls universal_router intent='category_availability_check'.

scenarios.name: Feasibility check returns found=false — offer a different day or the other treatment before falling to a message

history.content: Do you have anything for a relaxation massage this week?
One moment.

{"status": "success", "intent": "category_availability_check", "uni_router_intent": "category_availability_checked", "found": "false", "category_resolved": "Relaxation or Classic Massage", "category_min_duration_minutes": "45", "exact_appointment_type_pending": "", "check_failed": ""}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent tells the caller, in its OWN words (the tool result has no message field on this path — there is nothing to recite even accidentally), that there's no room today, then offers to check a different day or see if Remedial Massage has room instead — NOT a direct jump to 'I can pass this on to the clinic'. FAIL if agent asks about tier, add-ons, or duration for Relaxation/Classic Massage after being told there's no room, claims availability exists, invents a specific message-field-sounding phrase, or skips straight to the leave-a-message offer without mentioning either escape route first. Also FAIL if the agent says there's no room 'this week' (or any span wider than today) — the check only looked at today.

scenarios.name: Feasibility check returns found=true — acknowledge briefly, then continue normal narrowing

history.content: Does anyone have room for a remedial massage today?
One moment.

{"status": "success", "intent": "category_availability_check", "uni_router_intent": "category_availability_checked", "found": "true", "category_resolved": "Remedial Massage", "category_min_duration_minutes": "45", "exact_appointment_type_pending": "true", "check_failed": "", "message": "Yes, there's room for that today."}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent briefly acknowledges availability in its own words (something like 'Good news, we do have room today', never reciting the message field verbatim) and then asks the ADD-ON QUESTION ('Would you like Dry Needling, Cupping, or a Salt Scrub added to that, or just the massage on its own?') since no add-on/tier/duration has been stated yet. FAIL if agent calls confirm_service directly without asking the still-unresolved add-on question, re-runs category_availability_check again this turn, or speaks the message field's exact wording.

scenarios.name: Feasibility check returns check_failed=true — say nothing about availability, fall through to normal narrowing silently

history.content: Does anyone have room for a remedial massage today?
One moment.

{"status": "success", "intent": "category_availability_check", "uni_router_intent": "category_availability_checked", "found": "false", "category_resolved": "", "category_min_duration_minutes": "", "exact_appointment_type_pending": "", "check_failed": "true", "message": "I wasn't able to check that right now — let me try the usual way instead."}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent says NOTHING about availability one way or the other (no 'there's no room', no 'good news') and instead proceeds directly with the next unresolved HOW TO NARROW IT DOWN question for Remedial Massage — the ADD-ON QUESTION. FAIL if agent tells the caller there's no availability, recites the tool's message field, or offers the different-day/other-treatment escape routes (those are only for a genuine found=false result, not a check failure).

scenarios.name: Caller states a length in the same breath — check STILL fires, with requested_duration_minutes included (conv_1801m3bgv9b1fga9rr38mq7aa5ct regression)

history.content: I was wondering if you had any times this afternoon around five o'clock for a one-hour remedial massage.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks exactly one filler phrase then calls universal_router intent='category_availability_check' with payload service_category='remedial_massage' AND requested_duration_minutes=60 (a plain integer, from 'one-hour') — with zero other questions asked first. FAIL if agent skips the check and goes straight to the ADD-ON QUESTION (the pre-fix regression: a stated length used to wrongly disqualify this check), omits requested_duration_minutes, sends a non-numeric value for it, or asks about tier/add-on/duration before checking.

scenarios.name: Feasibility check returns found=true with available_practitioner_names — speak the names, not the message field, then continue narrowing

history.content: I was wondering if you had any times this afternoon around five o'clock for a one-hour remedial massage.
One moment.

{"status": "success", "intent": "category_availability_check", "uni_router_intent": "category_availability_checked", "found": "true", "category_resolved": "Remedial Massage", "category_min_duration_minutes": "75", "exact_appointment_type_pending": "true", "check_failed": "", "available_practitioner_names": "Bank and Gene", "message": "Yes, there is room today."}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent's spoken reply names Bank and Gene specifically as who has room (using the available_practitioner_names value as-is, not inventing other names or dropping one of the two), names the DAY only (today) with the one-hour length — never claiming room 'this afternoon' or 'around five', since the check covered the whole day — then asks the ADD-ON QUESTION next. FAIL if agent says they have room this afternoon / at or around five, gives a generic 'we have room' with no names, invents a practitioner not in the list, recites the message field's exact wording, or calls confirm_service directly without asking the still-unresolved add-on question.

scenarios.name: Feasibility check returns found=false — offer a different day, the other treatment, OR Ning (not just the first two)

history.content: Does anyone have room for a remedial massage this afternoon?
One moment.

{"status": "success", "intent": "category_availability_check", "uni_router_intent": "category_availability_checked", "found": "false", "category_resolved": "Remedial Massage", "category_min_duration_minutes": "45", "exact_appointment_type_pending": "", "check_failed": ""}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent's offer includes THREE options — a different day, the other treatment (Relaxation/Classic Massage), and checking with Ning (our premium therapist) — not just the first two. FAIL if Ning is omitted from the offer, or if the agent implies the found=false result already covered Ning (it never does — this check never searches her).

scenarios.name: Stated length the category doesn't offer comes back check_failed — say nothing about room, narrow normally

history.content: Hi, is anyone free today for a three-hour remedial massage?
One moment.

{"status": "success", "intent": "category_availability_check", "uni_router_intent": "category_availability_checked", "found": "false", "category_resolved": "", "category_min_duration_minutes": "", "exact_appointment_type_pending": "", "available_practitioner_names": "", "check_failed": "true", "message": "No 180-minute option in this category to check."}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent says nothing about whether anyone has room (neither yes nor no), does not read the message field aloud, and asks the ADD-ON QUESTION (Dry Needling, Cupping, or a Salt Scrub, or on its own) as the next step. FAIL if agent tells the caller there is no room, claims room, says 'no 180-minute option', or makes any tool call this turn.

scenarios.name: found=false for a named day — say there's no room on THAT day, not today

history.content: Does anyone have room for a relaxation massage on Thursday?
One moment.

{"status": "success", "intent": "category_availability_check", "uni_router_intent": "category_availability_checked", "found": "false", "category_resolved": "Relaxation or Classic Massage", "category_min_duration_minutes": "60", "exact_appointment_type_pending": "", "available_practitioner_names": "", "check_failed": "", "message": "internal"}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent says there's no room on Thursday (not 'today') with the standard therapists and offers a different day, Remedial Massage instead, or Ning. FAIL if agent says 'today', names Aek, or skips the offer.
